en: One thing at a time.
Start with the smallest piece that works.
Slow is smooth, smooth is fast.
You do not have to finish it today.
Make it work, then make it right.
The hard part is starting. You just did.
Read the error message. All of it.
A rough draft beats a perfect plan.
Small steps still get there.
Today only needs one good hour.
Name it well and half the bug is gone.
Deleting code counts as progress.
Ask early. It is cheaper than guessing.
The simplest thing that could possibly work.
You are allowed to not know yet.
Write it down before you forget why.
Sleep is a debugging tool.
Nothing looks as bad at noon as it did at 2am.
Begin. The rest follows.
A test you can trust is worth an hour.
Progress, not perfection.
Leave it better than you found it.
Ship something small today.

If it hurts, do it more often.

Everything is hard before it is easy.

Tidy desk, tidy diff.

Curiosity beats cleverness.

Steady beats fast.

Look at the data before the theory.
Give the problem a name.
Good enough today beats perfect never.
Stand up. Stretch. Then look again.
Most walls have a door somewhere.
You are closer than you think.
Read it out loud. The bug hears itself.
A short function is a kind one.
Reproduce it first. Then fix it.
Yesterday's mess is today's lesson.
Keep a list. Free the head.
Say no to one thing today.
The plan will change. Plan anyway.
Ask what problem this really solves.
Every expert wrote bad code first.
Understanding is worth the detour.
Do the next right thing.
Half an hour of quiet is enough.
It is fine to restart the thought.
The code you did not write cannot break.
Check the obvious thing twice.
Kindness scales better than cleverness.
Finish one thing before opening another.
Silence the notifications for an hour.
You will understand this in a week.
Old code was written by someone tired.
Fewer moving parts, fewer surprises.
Say what you mean in the commit message.
The boring solution usually wins.
Break it into pieces you can hold.
One green test is a foothold.
Start where you are.
Doubt is not a reason to stop.
Version control forgives everything.
Make the change easy, then make it.
Notice what went right today.
A question asked is a day saved.
Work like you have all morning.
Perfect is the enemy of shipped.
Pick the thing you are avoiding.

Being stuck is information.
Take the simple path this time.

The deadline is not the whole story.
Care about the work, not the applause.
Close the tabs you are not using.
Look up from the screen now and then.
Small refactors, often.
An hour of reading saves a day of typing.

Leave a note for tomorrow you.
Do the thing you can finish.
Learning slowly is still learning.
Give the idea a night to settle.
Some days the win is showing up.
Draw the box before you fill it.
Ask for the review early.
Two small commits beat one large one.
Delete the clever bit.

Write the README first.
There is always a smaller step.
Keep going. Quietly is fine.
A good morning is a slow one.
You get to choose what matters today.
Enough for now is enough.
